block.heading: Booking Management Only or Full Management: What's Included
rows: Booking management fit
Booking management only is the right fit when you live close by and already have cleaners and maintenance people you can rely on.
Booking management scope

We handle inquiries, guest screening, reservations, guest messages and reviews inside your own platform accounts. Master calendar management and dynamic pricing are optional services you choose one by one, and adding dynamic pricing means giving us the access to change your rates.
What stays with you

You arrange and pay for cleaning and maintenance. You also look after key handover, restocking, damage follow-up and on-site help when a guest has an urgent problem, and you set your own rates if you don't choose dynamic pricing.
Full management

If you want the property to run without you being involved day to day, full management adds pricing, calendar control, listing optimization, damage claims, and permit and tax support. It also covers coordinating local partners for cleaning, key handover and maintenance.
Fees and transition

Your existing bookings stay in place with any of our [management options and onboarding](/). Full management costs 10% of rental revenue plus USD 100 a month in software fees per listing. We invoice it with your monthly statement, and you pay within 7 days by ACH or card. Reservations-only services are chosen à la carte, including master calendar management at USD 50 per listing per month and dynamic pricing at USD 75 per listing per month. These are billed monthly in advance, with no 10% management fee and no monthly software fee.
Dynamic pricing

With [Dynamic Pricing](/dynamic-pricing/), we check and adjust your nightly rates by hand in your accounts at least once a day. We base each change on local demand data for the next 180 days, market comparisons and your listing's booking trends.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Can I engage you just to coordinate turnover cleaning while keeping listing management and guest communication with my current team?
items.answer: Yes. You can hire us just to coordinate turnover cleaning, and your current team keeps handling listing management and guest communication. We take care of all contact with local cleaning partners and pass on the schedules from your booking calendar along with your special requests.

items.question: How much should I charge for Airbnb cleaning?
items.answer: Under full management, we propose a guest cleaning fee that covers the partner's turnover invoice, including laundry and restocking. We compare it with similar listings nearby so the guest's total stays competitive. The fee goes live only after you approve it. We review it whenever the partner's rate changes, and at least every 6 months. Cleaning fees come to you with each booking payout and are excluded from the rental revenue we use to calculate our 10% management fee.

items.question: Can you coordinate turnovers through my existing property-management or cleaning app, or would I need to change systems?
items.answer: No, you don't need to change systems. We connect cleaning assignments to most major property-management platforms through a direct calendar link or your channel manager. If your cleaning app offers team or partner access, we work inside it. If it doesn't, we sync turnovers from your platform calendars.

items.question: If a guest reports a missed cleaning task at arrival, how quickly can your partners return to correct it?
items.answer: The cleaning partner comes back within 6–24 hours to redo the missed area, at no extra cost to you. If that partner can't return within that window, we send a different local partner to make the correction.

items.question: Which conditions, such as severe smoke residue, bodily fluids or pest contamination, are outside turnover-cleaning scope and require specialist treatment?
items.answer: Turnover cleaning doesn't cover severe smoke residue, blood or other bodily fluids beyond normal bathroom use, pest infestations, animal waste beyond routine pet hair, or any repair and restoration work. When our cleaning partners find any of these conditions, they photograph them. We then arrange a separate assessment by a licensed specialist, such as a biohazard, odor-remediation or pest-control company, and the specialist invoices you directly.

items.question: How do cleaners distinguish forgotten belongings from trash, and who handles storage and return of items found during a turnover?
items.answer: Our cleaning partners throw away only items that are clearly disposable, such as food leftovers, empty packaging and used toiletries. Anything that could have value, including clothing, chargers, documents and jewelry, gets photographed, bagged, labeled and kept as a found item. The partner stores it securely for 30 days. We contact the guest through the booking platform within 24 hours, and if they want the item back, we arrange shipping at their cost.

items.question: Can you handle laundry for a smaller property with no washer or dryer, or when its machines break down?
items.answer: Yes. When your property has no washer or dryer, we arrange for a local laundry partner to collect the used linens and bring back clean sets. For this off-site laundry service, you keep 3 full sets of linens and towels for each bed and bathroom. If your machines break down, we move that turnover to off-site laundry the same day and arrange the appliance repair through our maintenance partners.

items.question: What checkout-to-check-in window do you require for my property, including days when several of my units turn over at once?
items.answer: We need at least 4 hours between checkout and check-in for homes with up to 3 bedrooms, and 5 hours for larger homes. A standard 11 a.m. checkout with a 4 p.m. check-in meets both. When several of your units turn over on the same day, each unit gets its own partner crew, so the same window applies to every property.

block.heading: Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: If I sell my San Diego home, does my short-term rental license go to the buyer, or does the new owner have to apply again?
items.answer: Your license doesn’t pass to the buyer; the new owner has to apply for their own. As of November 2026, San Diego short-term rental licenses [can’t be transferred between owners or between properties](https://www.sandiego.gov/treasurer/short-term-residential-occupancy). When a buyer’s purchase depends on short-term rental income, we advise them to plan their own licensing path from the start instead of relying on the seller’s license.

items.question: Could I rent to traveling nurses or Navy families for 30 days or more instead of nightly guests, and would the same city rules apply?
items.answer: A stay of a full month or longer doesn’t need a San Diego STRO license. As of November 2026, the [STRO licensing rules](https://www.sandiego.gov/treasurer/short-term-residential-occupancy) cover stays of under one month. We treat stays of a full month or longer as a separate option with different licensing requirements, and we go by the full-month threshold rather than counting every 30-day stay as the same thing.

block.heading: The Compliance Team Keeps Your Licenses, Permits and Registrations Current

items.heading: Expiry alerts
paragraphs: Every permit, license and registration expiry date goes into our compliance calendar. We email you 90 days before each deadline, then send reminders at 60 and 30 days that list any missing documents, inspections or fees.

items.heading: Renewal filing
paragraphs: We prepare and file your renewal forms, help you submit them at least 30 days before expiry, and follow the application until the renewed permit is issued.

items.heading: Documents and access
paragraphs: You send us your current permit, proof of short-term rental insurance, any ownership or ID documents we ask for, and access to the licensing portal, or a delegate login where the portal offers one.

items.heading: Signatures and fees
paragraphs: Where an agent is allowed to file, you give us signed authorization. You sign any documents the permit holder must sign personally, attend owner interviews, and pay license and permit fees directly to the authority.

items.heading: Included software licenses
paragraphs: Under full management, your stated software fee covers our channel manager, pricing and calendar tools, so you don't buy separate licenses.

items.heading: Direct-booking trade-offs
paragraphs: Direct bookings avoid channel host fees. In exchange, you pay domain and card-processing costs directly, and you give up the guest-vetting and protection programs that booking platforms offer.

block.heading: What Are Your Contract, Insurance and Cancellation Terms?

items.heading: Contract and cancellation
items.text: We work month to month, with no long-term lock-in. You can cancel with 30 days’ notice, and there's no cancellation fee.

items.heading: Your property insurance
items.text: Before go-live, send us your property insurance policy. It has to explicitly cover short-term rental use with paying guests, and you need to keep it active for as long as we work together.

items.heading: Homeowner policy exclusions
items.text: If your homeowner policy excludes paying guests, you're exposed from the very first booking, and that policy doesn't meet our insurance requirement.

items.heading: Insured local partners
items.text: Every cleaning and maintenance partner we arrange has to carry its own insurance. We check that insurance, along with any required trade license, before their first job.

items.heading: Final management fee
items.text: After your end date, we invoice our 10% fee only on stays that have checked out by that date. Stays that check out later carry no fee from us.

items.heading: Final software charge
items.text: Your closing charges also include the monthly software fee per listing for the final month.

items.heading: Final statement payment
items.text: We send your final statement by the 10th of the following month, and payment is due within 7 days by ACH or card.

items.heading: Taxes on services
items.text: Our quoted management fee and service prices don't include taxes. If your state taxes these fees, we add sales tax as a separate line on your monthly invoice.

block.heading: Remote Maintenance Coordination and Fees

items.heading: Partner invoices
items.text: Local partners bill you directly at their own maintenance rates, and we add no markup.

items.heading: Coordination fees
items.text: Arranging repairs and following up on them are covered by our 10% remote management fee and our USD 100 monthly software fee per listing. There's no separate charge for coordination.
